What I'd tell a colleague

Five lessons.

  • Start with a real, repeated pain, not with the tool.
  • Organise your data first. One source of truth.
  • Do it right once, then save it as a skill.
  • Deliver where people already work: email, Teams, WhatsApp, in their language.
  • Always check the numbers. AI runs it, but you own it.
